payload.goal: Generate a single small soluble de novo protein candidate, evaluate its sequence and structure quality, and rank the result.
assumptions: No specific target sequence or structure is provided, so unconditional generation is used.
The generated backbone will be sufficient for sequence inference and basic QC.

missing_inputs.name: input_json
missing_inputs.reason: Required by protenix_v2 for structure prediction; no specific input JSON path was provided in the request.

nodes.intent: Generate a de novo soluble protein backbone using unconditional mode.
Predict the 3D structure and sequence for the generated backbone candidate.
Compute basic quality metrics (pLDDT, GRAVY, instability index) for the predicted candidate.
Rank the final candidate set based on structure predictions and QC metrics.

finalization.ranking_preference: prioritize candidates with high pLDDT and favorable stability metrics
